caption: The drawing features a single wooden rocking horse depicted in brown tones with shading effects to indicate contours and highlights. The rocking horse stands on two curved rocker rails, each extending past the front and back legs to rounded tips. The horse’s body is shown in profile, facing left, with a short upright mane, a simplified facial structure with a black dot for the eye, and a small ear. The saddle is lightly indicated with a darker brown patch atop the horse’s back. The tail is represented by a loose, grey brushstroke curving outward to the right. The background is a consistent, light tan color, and no additional objects or details are present except for a small, blue monogram with the letters "PPB" to the right of the rocker.
title: Hobby Horse Toy
